section_summary.extract_value: This section, "3.2.1. Divergent thinking, attention, and cognitive control," details a study investigating the relationship between divergent thinking, attentional flexibility (RT oddball effect), and cognitive control (N2 oddball effect). The findings, which replicate results from a previous Experiment 1, indicate that higher divergent thinking is associated with a smaller RT oddball effect and a larger N2 oddball effect. The study also examined the role of FSIQ-4 scores in these associations and mentions a correlation matrix (Table 1) that includes ATTA, FSIQ-4, and CAQ scores.
